name: Fusion CX
summary: Customer-experience (CX/BPO) outsourcer with 40 delivery centres in 13 countries; telecom is 47% of revenue.
financials: FY26 revenue ₹1,818 Cr (+37%), PAT ₹170 Cr (2.3x), RoNW 31%
positives: Fast growth with operating cash flow ₹264 Cr above PAT ₹170 Cr
21.5x P/E vs peer average 26.7x; ₹500 Cr fresh issue, ₹276 Cr repays debt
red_flags: Top-10 customers ≈50% of revenue; acquisition-led growth (goodwill ₹363 Cr)
Promoters hold 96% and sell ₹202 Cr in the OFS; tiny 10% retail quota
anchor: ₹315 Cr at ₹289; ~78% domestic MFs (Kotak, ICICI Pru, Motilal Oswal), Kotak Life, Kacholia's Bengal Finance
